verdict.rationale: Anytype documents both paths in the story. Local-only mode turns off its backup node entirely, so sync works only over the same local network. It also documents a self-hosted sync network with a team-maintained Docker image. Offline-first local storage underpins both, and a community user reports P2P sync working fine. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of running the self-hosted backend, and thin docs on the network configuration; switching network mode also requires exporting and re-importing into a new identity.
